scope: Controlled first-candidate exposure timing; candidate selected once using training only; not a general adaptive feature-selection fund.
uncertainty_interpretation: Working HAC standard-error penalty; no finite-sample or post-selection confidence guarantee.
certification_interpretation: Common shadow full candidate versus cash; not certification of the increase from provisional exposure.
analysis: All 100 paired markets; two-sided pointwise Student 95% interval, df=99; other contrasts and downside summaries descriptive; no outcome-dependent tuning or exclusions.
